parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> The timestamp must be on the minute.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description:
The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances.

> Call [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instances.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. For example, to query the first page, set this parameter to **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group in Resource Management to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs. By default, this parameter is empty, which means that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> The timestamp must be on the minute.
